'''''Ananas''''' is a plant [[genus]] in the family [[Bromeliaceae]].<ref name="p">{{cite web|url=http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=219647|title=World Checklist of Selected Plant Families: Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew|website=apps.kew.org}}</ref> It is native to [[South America]]. The genus contains ''Ananas comosus'', the [[pineapple]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite book|title=The Pineapple: Botany, Production, and Uses|last1=Bartholomew|first1=D. P.|last2=Paull|first2=Robert E.|last3=Rohrbach|first3=K. G.|date=2002|publisher=CABI|isbn=9780851999791|pages=23–28|language=en}}</ref>

==Species==
